name: What affects the cost of bathroom vanity installation?
description: Cost depends mostly on vanity type, countertop, sink, and plumbing changes; custom and wall-mounted jobs usually cost more.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of bathroom vanity installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest cost drivers are the **vanity style**, **countertop material**, **sink type**, and whether plumbing needs to be moved. Local Denver pricing varies widely, with labor often charged hourly and more complex installs costing more when the existing plumbing or wall conditions need extra work. Custom vanities generally cost more than stock units because they require more design, fabrication, and fitting.
